game.title: New York Jets at Detroit Lions

lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Detroit Lions -13.8 with a fair total of 49.3, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.346 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: New York Jets and Detroit Lions have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
